text.p: FIRSTPLUS Financial Group Inc said Wednesday it closed a $200 million committed warehouse facility, financed through a commercial paper conduit sponsored by the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd.
FIRSTPLUS said terms allow it to warehouse loans for up to one year. It said it expects the facility to be substantially increased over the succeeding three months.

"This facility gives FIRSTPLUS the ability to grow the company's on-balance-sheet portfolio, diversify funding sources, and increase working capital through the one-year warehousing period," FIRSTPLUS said in a statement.

FIRSTPLUS is a specialized consumer finance company that originates, buys services and securitizes consumer finance receivables, primarily home improvement loans, all secured by liens on the borrower's home.
